Implicit differentiation of the simple dominant pole gives mean n/2 and variance coefficient (7 sqrt(3)-6)/72; the unweighted residue is sqrt(3). The resulting exact balanced prefactor follows. The code supplies exhaustive finite certificates; no finite experiment is substituted for the analytic limit proof.

The complete coefficient-level enumerator gives every finite-length reservoir size, while a sharp evaluated n^{-1/2} penalty quantifies how GC balance changes the known rate.
